resolution.note: piped-check hook refuses while/until loops on pgrep by name; test covers refuse and PID/file/-P accept

title: Wait loops never condition on host-wide pgrep by process name
body:
Source: t-r53fan0 evidence 2026-11-17: predecessor t1z ran a Monitor-style loop `until grep -q ... .krn/tmp/fast.log && ! pgrep -u $UID -x node; do sleep 3; done` for 7h50m. `pgrep -x node` matches any node on the host (other lanes, MCP servers), so the loop never ends.
Outcome: lead/lane guidance and a guard reject wait loops conditioned on host-wide process absence (pgrep/pkill by name); waits key on a PID, a port, or a file verdict with a deadline.
Proof: a guard test rejects a fixture wait loop that polls pgrep -x node and accepts a PID-keyed one.
